subject: ACME - Post-demo pricing follow-up / cost model
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Demo recap — next steps and cost inputs

Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation. Quick post-demo recap and asks so we can turn the notes into a formal invoice estimate and cost model for your procurement team: 

1) Confirm expected token volumes (monthly) for the first 6–12 months. From the call I heard: ~40–60M tokens/month as a working range. Please confirm whether that should be 40M (low), 60M (target), or higher.

2) Confirm budget range for hosted inference (monthly) — you mentioned $12k–$20k as a ballpark. Is there a preferred cap we should respect when sizing options?

3) Unit economics target: you flagged wanting to be around $/1M tokens in the low-mid hundreds. If you can state a target $/1M tokens (e.g., $300/1M) it helps us optimize model/quantization vs latency tradeoffs in the estimate.

4) Compliance/procurement items: procurement@acme.com will need a line-item invoice and the cost model CSV + a short SOW for committed capacity (if we go dedicated).

I'm attaching a quick tokens worksheet I filled out from the call (ACME_token_estimate_20260325.xlsx). We'll use that to produce: (a) a 1M-token unit-price invoice estimate PDF, (b) a monthly cost model showing hosted vs reserved (dedicated) cost lines, and (c) a sensitivity tab (cache hit rates, prompt length).

Next steps: if you can confirm token volumes and your budget target today or tomorrow we'll push a formal invoice estimate and an annotated cost model for procurement. Happy to hop on a 15-min call with procurement if helpful.

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

---
Attachment: ACME_token_estimate_20260325.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap — next steps and cost inputs

Thanks Sean — good summary. Quick answers from our side after syncing with product and finance: 

- Token volumes: estimate ~45M tokens/month for launch months 1–3, trending to ~75M/month by month 6 if the pilot converts. Use 45M as low, 75M as upside.
- Budget: total monthly budget target for hosted inference is $15k–$18k to start. If we go dedicated/reserved we could stretch to $22k/month with a 6-month commit.
- Target unit price: product is comfortable around $300/1M tokens for a hosted setup, but procurement will push for lower on a committed reserved contract.

Procurement (cc'd) will want the invoice breakdown and a CSV cost model. Please include assumptions for average prompt tokens (we're using 850 tokens per request avg) and expected cache hit rate (we don't expect heavy reuse initially, assume 5–10%).

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Park
Head of Product, ACME Corp
alicia.park@acme.com

> On Mar 25, 2026, at 09:12, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation. Quick post-demo recap and asks so we can turn the notes into a formal invoice estimate and cost model for your procurement team: 
> > ...

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: ACME — invoice estimate and cost model (attached)

Appreciate the details, Alicia — good clarity. Attached are three artifacts for procurement and your finance team: 

1) Redwood_invoice_estimate_ACME_1Mtokens_v1.pdf — a line-item estimate showing our recommended hosted unit price and an alternate reserved (6-month commit) price with committed discount tiers. This PDF is meant for initial PO discussions. 
2) redwood_cost_model_ACME.csv — a CSV cost model with monthly scenarios (45M / 60M / 75M tokens), assumptions for avg prompt length (850 tokens), cache hit rate (5%), tokens per session, model choice (open-weights Llama-3-small vs gpt-4 style family), and per-token compute cost estimates. 
3) ACME_token_estimate_20260325.xlsx — the original worksheet from the call (same as earlier).

Highlights from the cost model (short summary):
- Hosted baseline (no commit): estimated $/1M tokens = $325 (at 45M/month) including model ops and support. Monthly total ~= $14.6k for 45M tokens.
- Hosted upside (75M/month): $/1M tokens drops to ~$300 due to fixed overhead amortization; monthly total ~= $22.5k.
- Dedicated/reserved (6-month commit): proposed committed discount reduces $/1M to ~$250 -> monthly total for 75M tokens ~= $18.75k.
- Key levers: quantization profile (Q4_0 vs int8), batching/throughput targets, and KV cache hit rate. We included sensitivity rows showing +/-10% prompt length and +/-5% cache.

Next steps I propose: 
- Procurement: review the attached PDF and ask any line-item clarifications. If needed, I can prepare a simple SOW for reserved capacity.
- Product: confirm the average prompt length and expected concurrency so Dev can validate latency assumptions.
- If ACME is comfortable with the reserved pricing, we can produce a DocuSign-ready SOW and start the reserved capacity onboarding timeline (~2–3 weeks after signed PO).

Attaching the files here for quick review. If procurement wants a single-page invoice with per-1M-token line item, I can produce that and email it directly.

Best — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redwood_cost_model_ACME.csv (CSV stub), Redwood_invoice_estimate_ACME_1Mtokens_v1.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Alicia Park <alicia.park@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Mar 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME — invoice estimate and cost model (attached)

Thanks Sean — procurement reviewed the PDF and CSV. A few requests before we move to PO: 

1) Can you provide a single-line invoice (PDF) that shows: unit price per 1M tokens, quantity (we will use 75 for 75M), and total. Separate rows for hosted vs reserved pricing.
2) Please include a committed-discount line for a 6-month commit (we'd like to see the math leading to the ~$250/1M number).
3) Can you add a short note on billing cadence (monthly invoices) and any overage policy if we exceed committed tokens in a month?

If you can send a DocuSign-ready SOW + the single-line invoice, we can route internally and aim to issue a PO next week. Also confirm the billing contact and remittance details for Redwood.

Thanks — Procurement (on behalf of ACME)
procurement@acme.com
